role: On-device regex shortcut for voice turns: a hand-authored list of 14 patterns whose handlers answer common factual questions (recovery, RHR, HRV, sleep, last workout, weight, max HR, LTHR, etc.) from the session archive and settings without calling an LLM.
types: DeterministicIntent: enum (@MainActor) — pattern catalog + matcher + spoken-reply helpers
DeterministicIntent.MatchContext: struct — now, SessionArchive, UserSettings handed to handlers
DeterministicIntent.Pattern: struct — id, regex triggers, handler closure
toplevel: static let patterns (110-399) defines 14 Pattern handlers as closures: recovery_score_today (todaysOvernightEntry → recoveryScore×10 → RecoveryScoreCalculator.displayScore + ScoreVerdict(score:).localizedWord; nil when no reliable overnight or score), resting_hr_today (archive.retrieveLightweightOrLog(entry) → vitalsSnapshot.restingHeartRate; a read failure is logged and falls through to the LLM), hrv_rmssd_today (entry.meanRMSSD), sleep_duration_last_night (sleepSnapshot.nightSleepMinutes + measuredSleepEfficiency when non-nil), last_workout_summary (first .workout entry in newest-first archive.entries; its active minutes, pauses left out (activeMinutes); 0 → day only), trained_recently ('yesterday' substring picks dayStart(isYesterday:); sums the active minutes of every .workout that day; always returns a string, 'No workout recorded…' when none), score_breakdown_today (session.scoreBreakdown.factors localized label + rounded score, list-formatted, plus ScoreVerdict.safeDisplayScore(compositeScore)), sleep_stages_last_night (deep/REM/stages/breakdown triggers — light sleep is not matched; totalSleepIncludingNapMinutes; deep/REM minutes or 'No sleep stage data' when either is nil), body_weight (settings.bodyWeightKg, imperial when UnitsPreferenceStore.current.resolved == .imperial), max_hr and lthr (settings value, nil below MaxHeartRate.minimumUserEntered), sleep_latency (sleepSnapshot.sleepLatencyMinutes), sleep_efficiency (measuredSleepEfficiency or a 'wasn't measured' sentence), total_session_count (counts of all / .workout / .overnight entries; always answers). Replies use String(localized:bundle: LanguageManager.appBundle). Session reads use retrieveLightweightOrLog. Apostrophe classes accept ' and ’ and an omitted apostrophe ('whats'). Reads archive:SessionArchive.entries, archive:SessionArchive.retrieveLightweight, ud:UnitsPreferenceStore (units preference), mem:UserSettings fields.

units.does: Returns the cached compiled regexes for this pattern via compiledTriggers(forPatternID:triggers:).

Returns the cached [NSRegularExpression] for a pattern id, compiling each trigger case-insensitively and caching on first use; a trigger that fails to compile is dropped and logged (warning) with the pattern id and error.

branches.effect: returns cached regexes; otherwise compiles, stores and returns

units.does: Finds the matching pattern and normalized utterance through matchedPattern(for:), runs the pattern's handler and returns the reply; returns nil (send to LLM) when the utterance is empty, nothing matches, or the handler returned nil.
calls: closure:Pattern.handler — the 14 handler closures in DeterministicIntent.patterns
reads: ud:fitness.unitsPreference (App Group suite via UnitsPreferenceStore.current, legacy standard-suite fallback; body_weight handler)

branches.cond: matchedPattern returned nil (empty utterance or no match)
matched handler returned nil (data not ready)
branches.effect: logs 'match=<id> but no data' and returns nil; otherwise logs 'served' and returns the answer

units.does: Normalizes the utterance and returns the first catalog pattern any of whose triggers matches it, with the normalized text; nil for an empty normalized utterance or no match. The matching half of tryMatch; DeterministicIntentTests drive it directly.
True when any compiled trigger of the pattern finds a match anywhere in the full normalized string.
Lowercases, trims whitespace/newlines, then trims '.?!,' from both edges.
Start of the current day for now, or start of the previous calendar day when isYesterday, using calendar.date(byAdding:.day,-1) (DST-safe).

branches.effect: ?? falls back to today's start (not reachable for Gregorian input); otherwise the previous day's start

units.does: Returns the newest reliable (isReliableForHRVAggregates) overnight archive entry whose midpoint (date + (endDate??date - date)/2) lies within the local day containing now; nil if none.

branches.effect: ?? uses entry.date → duration 0, midpoint = start date; an open session is matched by its start day

units.does: Spoken day label: RelativeDateTimeFormatter named/full ('today', 'yesterday', '3 days ago') for <14 days, else a localized 'MMMMd' date.

branches.effect: ?? Int.max → falls to the absolute date format
relative phrase with -max(0,days) (future dates say 'today'); otherwise MMMMd date

units.does: Formats minutes as a full spelled-out duration ('7 hours, 12 minutes') in the app locale; negative input clamped to 0.

branches.effect: allowed units hour+minute; else minute only

units.does: Formats body weight with the long unit name: whole pounds when imperial, one-decimal kilograms otherwise.

A workout's active minutes, pauses left out, as its workout card and the assistant's context count them: WorkoutActiveTime.seconds over the lightweight-decoded session's samples, with the entry's wall-clock span (endDate - date) standing in when there are no samples or the session can't be read; 0 when neither exists. Truncated to whole minutes.
units.entry: Called by the last_workout_summary and trained_recently pattern handlers.

branches.cond: no samples and no wall clock

units.does: Reply for trained_recently: 'Yes — you logged a workout.' when minutes <= 0, else 'Yes — you trained for <spoken duration>.'

branches.effect: returns the duration-less sentence; otherwise the duration sentence
